description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class `WorkWeekTest` that tests the `WorkWeek` entity's functionality within the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Leave module. It sets up test data, manipulates the WorkWeek object, persists it, and performs assertions to verify correct behavior.

classes.name: WorkWeekTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the `WorkWeek` entity in the Leave module of OrangeHRM. It verifies setting and retrieving work week length values and persistence behavior.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test setup by truncating existing WorkWeek records to ensure a clean database state for each test.

methods.name: testWorkWeek
methods.description: Creates a new WorkWeek object, assigns different work day lengths, persists it, retrieves it, and asserts that the stored values are as expected.
